```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidygeocoder)
library(tidyverse)
library(USAboundaries)
```

Get a base map of counties of Veriginia 
```{r}
us_counties(states="Virginia")

```

plot(us_counties(state = "Virginia")) 
```{r}
counties <- us_counties(states ="Virginia")
counties
#plot(us_states(states = "Virginia"))

```
```{r}
#geometry is sticky
counties |>
  select(name)

```
inspect the geographic side of the data 
```{r}
st_crs(counties)
```

let's geocode some locations with tidygeocoder

```{r}
locations <- geo(c("Blacksburg", "Charlottesville"))
locations

# make locations geographic
locations_sf <-st_as_sf(locations, 
                         coords = c("long", "lat"),
                         crs = 4326)
```
project the data 

```{r}
state_plane(state = "VA")
locations_proj <- st_transform(locations_sf, crs = "EPSG:32146")
counties_proj <- st_transform(counties, crs = "EPSG:32146")
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = counties_proj) +
  geom_sf(data = locations_proj)
```

```{r}
library(leaflet)
  
  leaflet() |>
    addTiles() |>
    addPolygons(data = counties,
              fillOpacity = 0,
              color = "#000",
              weight = 2) |>
  addMarkers(data = locations_sf, label = address)
```

install.packages(c(
  "sf",
  "osmdata",
  "ggplot2",
  "ggspatial",
  "dplyr"
))

```{r}
install.packages(c("sf", "ggplot2", "ggspatial"))

library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggspatial)

# Approximate Achimota Forest boundary coordinates
achimota_coords <- matrix(
  c(
    -0.227, 5.632,
    -0.219, 5.641,
    -0.205, 5.642,
    -0.192, 5.633,
    -0.190, 5.619,
    -0.204, 5.611,
    -0.221, 5.615,
    -0.227, 5.632
  ),
  ncol = 2,
  byrow = TRUE
)

# Create polygon
achimota_polygon <- st_polygon(list(achimota_coords)) |>
  st_sfc(crs = 4326) |>
  st_sf(name = "Achimota Forest Reserve", geometry = _)

# Create map
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = achimota_polygon,
    fill = "forestgreen",
    color = "darkgreen",
    alpha = 0.6,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.3) +
  annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "tl",
    which_north = "true",
    style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Achimota Forest Reserve, Accra, Ghana",
    subtitle = "Approximate boundary map created in R",
    caption = "Coordinate boundary is approximate and for teaching/research visualization",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
